page.notes: Greek passages (δὶς δὶ ἀσσῶν, ἴσον ὑψηλὸς ἐς' ἀπὸ γαίης) are doubtful; the letters were read with difficulty from the scan and are marked [?]. The word after "sapientiæ" in the Greek line and the Greek word ἀποσκιασμάτιον are read as printed, but the accents may be off. Long s is written as s throughout. The note "Sapientia consideratur" carries the list numbers 1 and 2 as printed. The page is mostly italic; the whole running text is wrapped in <i>. Paragraph breaks are not visible on this page, so the text runs as one paragraph.
